Created [index.html](./index.html) as the only file in the working directory. It includes the deterministic simulator, 100-second replay, procedural WebGL scene, combat and collapse effects, HUD, playback controls, and synthesized audio.

Both reference hashes matched: `82a5353d` and `2e8858d7`. The simulator uses the **2,800-centi-tile** air route implied by the waypoints and confirmed by those vectors.

The strategy pairs clustered cannon fire with staggered flak coverage and prioritizes enemies approaching the keep. It averaged **42.78 waves across 28 non-42 seeds**, including **42.70 on 12 fresh seeds**. Seed 42 scored **41.83**, falling at tick **1,693**.

I tested the local file in Firefox at 1280×650. Scrubbing back from the collapse reproduced an identical screenshot. Re-fire, speed persistence, endpoint hold, and restart also passed. Desktop Chrome FPS and audible mix quality remain unmeasured.
